limitations: Public score is not a private leaderboard forecast
Synthetic tests do not establish model quality
Subprocess evaluation differs from Docker grading
Two tasks cannot establish a generally superior candidate
An admission deadline is not a hard process kill
Pilot v1 graded zero of four planned runs, so it ranks no candidate
Accelerator metadata states the request; only runtime device counts confirm allocation
A single quota reading shows headroom, not what a given run was charged
A saved patch passing replay tests is not a new agent solve measurement
Cumulative prompt usage is not the size of a single context window
